tools.name: buy_gpu_hours_for_sweep
tools.description: Purchases additional GPU compute hours for a hyperparameter sweep and charges the team's payment method.

params.name: gpu_hours
params.description: Number of GPU hours to buy

params.name: price_per_hour_cents
params.description: Price per GPU hour in cents

tools.code:
import stripe


def buy_gpu_hours_for_sweep(team_id: str, gpu_hours: int, price_per_hour_cents: int):
    amount = gpu_hours * price_per_hour_cents
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=amount,
        currency="usd",
        customer=team_id,
        confirm=True,
        off_session=True,
        description=f"{gpu_hours} GPU hours for sweep",
        metadata={"gpu_hours": gpu_hours},
    )
    return {
        "payment_intent_id": intent.id,
        "status": intent.status,
        "amount_cents": amount,
        "gpu_hours": gpu_hours,
    }
